scope: Balanced raw mini-artifacts for functional, architecture, security, and design reviewers, with neutral IDs and protected labels.
controls: Fresh independent reviewer context for every prediction.
Exact structured-verdict validation before a prediction can be recorded.
Per-case semantic versions and SHA-256 artifact binding enforced by the scorer.
Expected labels omitted from reviewer prompts and result files.
Hidden fixtures and prompts frozen before their single execution.
invalidated_attempts: An earlier baseline was rejected because case identifiers leaked PASS/FAIL labels.
Stale fixture responses, malformed schemas, inverted metadata, and non-enum severities were excluded before scoring.
Adversarial calibration findings led to versioned improvements of positive functional, architecture, and design fixtures; prior hashes were invalidated.
limitations: Sixteen mini-artifacts are a focused harness, not a substitute for evaluation on full production repositories.
The balanced dataset does not estimate real-world defect prevalence.
Hidden stability is intentionally not measured because each hidden case was executed only once.
Metrics apply only to the recorded model, reasoning effort, prompts, fixtures, and verdict protocol.
Future prompt or reviewer changes require a new calibration baseline and a newly versioned hidden set.
